In nineteen sixty-eight Ford began designing a new

The objective was a car at or below two thousand
pounds,

if the fuel tank were located above the axle,

the Pinto would have been left with a very small
trunk.

That location was not unusual. It
was a commonplace at the time in American cars.
What was unusual was what was left behind it.

called
